cohort: Pregnant women who underwent a caesarean section between January 2016 and December 2019 at a tertiary referral hospital in Indonesia.
finding: The study found that the effectiveness of the hospital's tiered referral system for pregnant women with an indication for C-section still has room for improvement, as there was a gap between the number of referred cases and those who eventually underwent a C-section for the same indication.
birth_weight: Most babies were born with a normal weight (2500-3999 grams) (45.1%), while 54.9% were classified as having abnormal weight.
